_comment: Allowlist for vault -> content/ sync. Lives outside content/ because content/ is mirrored and app-owned files inside it can be deleted by sync. Only paths listed here are ever published; everything else in the vault (drafts, meta notes, .obsidian/) stays private.
_publish_gate_notes: Per-note switch on top of the folder allowlist, applied by scripts/publish_gate.mjs at sync time. Add a boolean `publish` property in the vault (Obsidian's Properties panel renders it as a checkbox); unchecked keeps the note out of content/ entirely, so it never reaches the public repo. publish_default: true means a note WITHOUT the field still publishes - set it to false to make the gate opt-in, but every note then needs `publish: true` before it goes live. Flipping a published note to false also removes the stale copy from content/, which the additive sync would otherwise leave behind.
_private_notes: Vault-only material is stripped from the published copy by scripts/scrub_private.mjs at sync time (not render time, so it does not depend on the checked-out branch). Mark it either as a callout whose type is listed in private_callout_types or whose title starts with 'DM', or with a <!-- dm:start --> / <!-- dm:end --> fence for whole sections. Both stay readable in Obsidian. publish_from_vault.sh runs --check and refuses to build if any private block survives.
